title: Visible From Space: How India Built a 30 GW Clean Power Plant 5x Larger Than Paris

scenes.voiceoverText: In Western Gujarat lies the Rann of Kutch — a blinding salt desert where nothing grows.
scenes.captionMarkup: In *Western Gujarat* lies the *Rann of Kutch* — a blinding *salt desert* where nothing grows.

scenes.voiceoverText: Today, India is turning it into the largest power plant on Earth — visible from space! Stay with me — one locked megacity number shows just how gigantic this is.
scenes.beatACaption: Today, India is turning it into the *largest power plant* on Earth — *visible from space!*
scenes.beatBCaption: Stay with me — *one locked megacity* number shows just how *gigantic* this is.

scenes.voiceoverText: Back in 2014, all of India generated just 2.8 gigawatts of solar — importing almost every panel.
scenes.captionMarkup: Back in *2014,* all of India generated just *2.8 gigawatts* of solar — *importing* almost every panel.

scenes.voiceoverText: A decade later, India crossed 100 gigawatts — a massive 38-times surge into the global top three!
scenes.captionMarkup: A decade later, India crossed *100 gigawatts* — a massive *38-times surge* into the *global top three!*

scenes.voiceoverText: Its crown jewel is Khavda: 30 gigawatts of solar and giant 5.2-megawatt wind turbines powering 16 million homes!
scenes.captionMarkup: Its crown jewel is *Khavda:* *30 gigawatts* of solar and *5.2 MW turbines* powering *16 million homes!*

scenes.voiceoverText: With zero fresh water in the desert, waterless robots sweep salt dust every night across corrosion-proof bifacial panels.
scenes.captionMarkup: With *zero fresh water,* waterless *robots* sweep dust nightly across *bifacial solar panels.*

scenes.voiceoverText: Unlocked: Khavda spans 538 square kilometres — five times larger than the entire city of Paris!
scenes.captionMarkup: Unlocked: Khavda spans *538 sq km* — *five times larger* than the entire city of *Paris!*

scenes.voiceoverText: From Gujarat's Khavda to Rajasthan's Bhadla, Rewa, and Karnataka's Pavagada — mega solar parks now span India!
scenes.captionMarkup: From *Khavda* to Rajasthan's *Bhadla,* *Rewa,* and *Pavagada* — mega solar parks now *span India!*

scenes.voiceoverText: Now, the honest part: solar drops at sunset, and India still imports most raw polysilicon wafers.
scenes.captionMarkup: Now, the *honest* part: solar drops at *sunset,* and India still imports most *polysilicon wafers.*

scenes.voiceoverText: That is why ₹24,000 crore solar PLI fabs, domestic cells, and giant grid batteries are scaling fast. A nation that burns imported fuel is a hostage. A nation that harvests its own desert sun is sovereign.
scenes.beatACaption: That is why *₹24,000 crore* solar fabs, *domestic cells,* and *grid batteries* are scaling fast.
scenes.beatBCaption: A nation burning imported fuel is a *hostage.* A nation harvesting its own sun is *sovereign.*

scenes.captionMarkup: What powers India's future best — *Solar, Nuclear,* or *Green Hydrogen?* Drop *one word* below.
